properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JS SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 implementations shipped as elliptic's hashing layer (inside ganache/web3). No direct first-party use; SHA-1 exposure is library-internal. Linked to the bare hash.js package entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum transaction-signing curve. The app's in-process ganache dev chain (src/blockchain.js:181 ganache.provider()) generates deterministic secp256k1 accounts and signs every deployed transaction with ECDSA-secp256k1 through this package. Changeable only by the Ethereum protocol, not by this repo; observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped KDF capability: OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey (single-iteration MD5) available in the installed tree via evp_bytestokey; used internally by browserify cipher wrappers. No first-party call site in src/ — availability is the inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency entry: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 ships in this build as a transitive dependency of sshpk (via request → ganache's HTTP-signature chain). It implements the bcrypt-based PBKDF used for OpenSSH private-key KDF. Available in the shipped node_modules; no direct call site in the app's own src/ code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH key-agreement capability available in the installed tree (crypto-browserify's ECDH over Node crypto). Verified no first-party createECDH/crypto call exists in src/, bin/ or scripts/; availability is what the inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature capability ships in the build via tweetnacl@0.14.5, pulled in by sshpk (via request/ganache) for OpenSSH key signing/verification. Changeable here only insofar as the request/sshpk dependency chain can be replaced; no direct Ed25519 call site in the app's own src/ code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JS ECDSA on secp256k1/P-256/K-256 inside ganache/web3 (browserify-sign, ethereumjs stack); transitively exercised when the in-process ganache provider signs dev transactions. Shipped capability, no direct first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Available X25519 key agreement in the shipped tree (tweetnacl crypto_scalarmult). No first-party call site — recorded as shipped capability of the locked dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum's keccak256 (pre-standard SHA-3 variant) for transaction hashing and ABI selectors, exercised transitively on every deploy/send through the in-process ganache provider. Not Shor-relevant; recorded as shipped hashing capability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.x (browserify) and its @types stub ship in the build as transitive dependencies of the web3/ganache Ethereum stack (via ethereum-cryptography/bip39/browserify-aes chains). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password KDF for Ethereum V3 keystore file key derivation, locked via the web3/ganache toolchain. Shipped; no first-party call site in this repo's own code — recorded as shipped capability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Symmetric authenticated encryption (tweetnacl secretbox) available in the shipped tree. Not Shor-relevant (Grover gives only square-root speedup); no first-party call site — recorded as shipped capability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl is a real crypto provider in the shipped build (sshpk chain via request/ganache); it carries NaCl's Ed25519, X25519, XSalsa20-Poly1305 primitives — all quantum-unsafe. Presence is the inventory question: it ships whether or not the shell's own src/ calls it directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
